I found one bug in the uncommitted changes, in `docs/service.py:38`. `rename()` loads the document with `self.repo.get(doc_id)` instead of `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`, so it never checks who owns the document.

Any user can rename any other user's document. The `NotFound` that hides which ids exist is skipped too. `update_body` and `delete` both go through `_owned`.

The fix is to change that line to `document = self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`.

I only read the diff and the file. I didn't run any tests.

findings.summary: rename() fetches the document with repo.get() instead of self._owned(user_id, doc_id), so it never checks ownership.
findings.failure_scenario: User A calls rename(user_id=A, doc_id=<B's doc>, title='x'). The document is loaded, retitled and saved, so any user can rename any other user's document. Because _owned() is skipped, the NotFound that hides which ids exist is skipped too. Every other mutating method (update_body, delete) goes through _owned. Fix: document = self._owned(user_id, doc_id).
